user_stories.title: US-01: Check a JSON document without calling GitLab
user_stories.description: As a developer, I want to validate a JSON document offline so that I can catch mistakes before the tool writes anything to GitLab.
acceptance_criteria: Only project, title and description are declared.
Running the command contacts no GitLab endpoint.
Every reported error points at the file and the field.
definition_of_done: The command runs without a token in the environment.
A broken document reports at least one error.
notes: This file is the smallest payload that still validates. Copy it as a starting point.
